title: Add Active Text Block Island Commit Runner
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository, Checklist target, and Evidence target before editing Editor.
The runner bypasses the text-block authoring boundary or active-island commit resolver.
The runner bypasses the Backend client, Backend revision gate, or Editor stale-gated runtime apply path.
The runner applies a Backend mutation result against an older Editor runtime state when a newer local active-island draft exists.
The runner enables visible typing UI, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, or React canvas input binding.
The live Backend harness cannot prove the runner against a loopback Backend server.
Focused or full Editor gates fail after the runner is added.
Project Control registration promotes broad Editor, Backend, Core, frontend, or FlowDoc readiness from this bounded evidence.
verificationTarget: Editor can commit the active text-block island draft through FlowDocBackendClient.commitMutation, expose pending commit state before the request resolves, apply the Backend mutation result through the existing stale-gated runtime path, preserve newer local active-island draft state for older Backend responses, and prove the runner against a live loopback Backend harness without enabling visible text input.
summary: Done: Editor commit 747a7269838d457b940251be33cd275d80f9c3b4 adds an active text-block island commit runner and extends the live Backend compatibility harness to exercise that runner after read, migration, reorder, and rich-inline mutation. Focused and full Editor gates passed; broad Editor readiness, visible typing UI, WYSIWYG behavior, and frontend readiness remain unpromoted.
